decisions.rule: Golgy counts physical cards in the selected base; its own reduction has floor3, before other reducers. West only reduces when evolved. Big uses fixed colorless2 if all three civilizations occur in mana.

Each Kohaku under an active creature grants one reducer; other printed abilities are not inherited. Entry protection carries across normal evolution, not insertion under a different creature (47066,47069).
Golgy selects its ramp count before a simultaneous move (42521,48286). Reveal/search and rest ordering obey Q.Q.QX. Revealed cards remain physically in their protected deck location until moved.

All still-present prior base cards are moved from grave as one faceup shield or under one NEO/evolution creature. Selecting the under mode without any legal target leaves the cards in grave (48287). A saved creature was not destroyed.

GNEO with bases is an evolution creature. Golgy alternate victory respects defeat protection/replacement. Aophe forbids entry-turn attacks including speed, evolution and mach. West watches player attacks and executes one legal face for free.
QA44212: West triggers for each player attack until its optional look is actually used. Declining an earlier attack does not spend its once-per-turn ability.

QA46862: super-soul raid refers to the current creature and its evolution conditions; an ordinary Orugate cannot receive a base through a borrowed raid. Moving a card under a creature is not evolution and does not trigger becoming-an-evolution-base abilities (46847).
